name: DeafChurch First Coast
tagline: Bringing Anglican worship to the Deaf community in American Sign Language
description: DeafChurch First Coast is a church plant serving the Deaf Community in Northeast Florida. Christ The King serves as the host church, supporting the new mission as it seeks to establish a Deaf congregation in St. Augustine.
familyInfo: Fr. Bob and Kathy have six adopted adult children (two of whom are Deaf) and 12 grandchildren.
publicationTitle: DEAFCHURCH 21: Vision for a New Generation
